title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Polar Mint 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Polar Mint Nic Salt e-liquid is an icy treat for vapers who crave a cool and refreshing vaping experience. With each inhale, this flavour delivers a crisp blast of fresh Mint, providing a cool and clean menthol hit that’s perfect for all-day use. With a 50VG/50PG blend, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are perfect for MTL vape kits and pod systems. These e-liquids offer smooth throat hits and quick nicotine relief, ideal for vapers seeking an alternative to traditional tobacco products. Available in both 10mg and 20mg strengths, this e-liquid offers an arctic-cool flavour that never goes out of style. Pukka Juice are a UK-based brand famous for their bold and unique e-liquid creations. The Pukka Juice 5000+ range captures the best of disposable vape flavours in a format suited to reusable vape devices. Other flavours in the range include Tropical, Pineapple Ice, and Raspberry Pomegranate.
